claims.text: Alternatives to TMP-SMX: trimethoprim with dapsone, clindamycin plus primaquine, pentamidine, or atovaquone (mild pneumonia only).
claims.quote: Alternative regimens, which are given for 21 days, use: Trimethoprim with dapsone Clindamycin plus primaquine Pentamidine Atovaquone (for mild pneumonia)

claims.text: Pentamidine's main limit is toxicity: acute kidney injury, hypotension, hypoglycemia.
claims.quote: The major limitation of pentamidine is the high frequency of toxic adverse effects, including acute kidney injury, hypotension, and hypoglycemia.

claims.text: Prophylaxis when TMP-SMX isn't tolerated: dapsone or aerosolized pentamidine.
claims.quote: if this antibiotic is not tolerated, dapsone or aerosolized pentamidine can be used.
